concept.hr: Prvo zagrade, zatim · i :, na kraju + i −; ravnopravne slijeva nadesno
concept.en: Brackets first, then · and :, then + and −; of equal rank, left to right

summary.hr: Izračunaj izraz korak po korak dok se stablo računa sklapa, pomakni zagrade i vidi zašto strogo slijeva nadesno griješi.
summary.en: Work out an expression step by step as its tree folds up, move the brackets, and see why strictly left to right goes wrong.

concept.hr: Zagrada, pa · i :, pa + i −: 26; strogo slijeva nadesno dalo bi 70
concept.en: Bracket, then · and :, then + and −: 26; strictly left to right gives 70
